title: Nextech3D.ai provides update in acquisition of remaining ARway shares, strengthening AI platform
excerpt: Nextech3D.ai CEO Evan Gappelberg joined Steve Darling from Proactive to provide an update on the company's proposed acquisition of all outstanding shares...
content_html:
Proactive

Mon, July 27, 2026 at 10:33 AM CDT

Nextech3D.ai CEO Evan Gappelberg joined Steve Darling from Proactive to provide an update on the company's proposed acquisition of all outstanding shares of ARway Corporation that it does not already own, following the recent signing of a definitive agreement between the two companies.

On a standalone basis, ARway generated approximately $1.58 million in revenue and $1.52 million in gross profit for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting the strength of its augmented reality navigation business.

Nextech currently owns approximately 40% of ARway's outstanding shares, while management and insiders hold an additional 20%. Upon completion of the transaction, expected in October 2026, ARway will become a wholly owned subsidiary, bringing its technology, intellectual property, and event technology assets fully under the Nextech umbrella.

Gappelberg said combining ARway with Map Dynamics will create a more unified AI-powered platform for the global events industry. Management expects the integration to accelerate product innovation, eliminate duplicate overhead, improve operational efficiency, and expand recurring SaaS revenue opportunities.

The company believes consolidating its event technology portfolio will further strengthen Nextech's position as an AI-first technology company focused on event technology, augmented reality, spatial computing, and digital engagement while creating long-term value through a more streamlined business.

content_html_zh:
积极主动的

美国中部时间 2026 年 7 月 27 日星期一上午 10:33

Nextech3D.ai 首席执行官 Evan Gappelberg 与 Proactive 的 Steve Darling 一起提供了有关该公司拟收购其尚未拥有的 ARway Corporation 所有已发行股票的最新信息，此前两家公司最近签署了一份最终协议。

在独立基础上，ARway 在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的财年中产生了约 158 万美元的收入和 152 万美元的毛利润，凸显了其增强现实导航业务的实力。

Nextech 目前拥有 ARway 约 40% 的流通股，管理层和内部人士另外持有 20%。 交易预计于 2026 年 10 月完成，ARway 将成为全资子公司，将其技术、知识产权和活动技术资产完全纳入 Nextech 旗下。

Gappelberg 表示，ARway 与 Map Dynamics 的结合将为全球活动行业创建一个更加统一的人工智能平台。 管理层预计此次整合将加速产品创新、消除重复开销、提高运营效率并扩大 SaaS 经常性收入机会。

该公司相信，整合其活动技术产品组合将进一步巩固 Nextech 作为一家专注于活动技术、增强现实、空间计算和数字参与的人工智能优先技术公司的地位，同时通过更精简的业务创造长期价值。
